ns2:section.sectionText: This is an online honors section for undergraduates who are excellent in mathematics and enjoy a rigorous, abstract class. Interested students with A's in previous math courses should e-mail mathadvising@illinois.edu with the subject line "Online Honors Math 347 request" and include name, UIN, and reason for wanting the class. Students are typically advised to complete Math 241 prior to applying for honors Math 347. Approval for the honors section does not guarantee an open seat in this section. An on-campus-only section is also available at MWF 11am; please see section D1H.
